name: Vendor Performance core scenarios
description: Real Vendor Performance Q&A pairs grounded in the synthetic seed data (see data/generate_seed_data.py): a best-performer question (Highland Textile Mills), a worst-performer question (Riverside Footwear Supply), a late/short-shipment detail question for Riverside, and a cross-vendor OTIF ranking question. NOT currently wired to a runnable eval CLI gate: `adk eval` (google-adk 2.5.0) doesn't support YAML Agent Config agents (confirmed 2026-07-26 against ADK source, see architecture spec section 8) -- these cases are content-ready but need either a different eval mechanism or an ADK fix before they run as a quality gate.

parts.text: How is Highland Textile Mills performing on deliveries?
Highland Textile Mills is our strongest vendor on delivery performance, with a 90% on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate over the recent scorecard period, based on internal vendor scorecard data.
Which vendor has the worst on-time-in-full delivery rate?
Riverside Footwear Supply has the worst on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate among our vendors, at just 30%, based on internal vendor scorecard data.
Which purchase orders from Riverside Footwear Supply were late or short-shipped?

Several of Riverside Footwear Supply's recent purchase orders were late, arrived short of the ordered quantity, or both, based on internal purchase order data -- consistent with the vendor's weak overall on-time-in-full performance.
How do our vendors compare on delivery performance?

Based on internal vendor scorecard data, Highland Textile Mills leads with a 90% on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate, Cascade Apparel Co and Meridian Footwear Group are roughly tied in the middle at around 70% OTIF each, and Riverside Footwear Supply is clearly the weakest performer at around 30% OTIF.
